verses.en: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
verses.sm: Semi Ua latalata ona po e oti ai Tavita; ona fai ai lea o mavaega ma lona atalii o Solomona, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
verses.sm: O le a ou alu i le ala o le lalolagi uma; ia e faamalosi, ma ia e faatamatane;

verses.en: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:
verses.sm: ia e tausia foi sauniga a le ALII lou Atua, ina ia e savali i ona ala, ia tausi i ana sauniga, ma ana poloaiga, ma ana faamasinoga, ma ana tulafono e pei ona tusia i le tulafono a Mose, ina ia manuia oe i mea uma e te faia, ma mea uma e te faasagasaga i ai;

verses.en: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.
verses.sm: ina ia faatumauina e le ALII lana afioga na ia fetalai mai ai ia te au, ua faapea mai, Pe afai e tausia e au fanau lo latou ala, ia savavali i oʻu luma ma le faamaoni, ma o latou loto atoa, ma lo latou manatu atoa, ua faapea mai o ia, ona le motu lea o lou gafa i le nofoalii o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
verses.sm: Ua e iloa foi le mea na faia e loapo le tama a Seruia ia te au, o le mea na ia faia ia i laua o e na pule i “au a Isaraelu o Apineru le atalii o Neru ma Amase le atalii o Ietero, na ia fasia, ua ia faamaligiina o la toto faatagataotaua ina o leai se taua; ua ia tuu foi le toto o e na fasi faatagataotaua i lona fusi sa i lona sulugatiti, ma ona see sa i ona vae.

verses.en: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
verses.sm: Ia e faia foi e tusa ma lou poto, a e aua ne“ alu ifo lona ulusiná ma le filemu i le tuugamau.

verses.en: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.
verses.sm: A ia e agalelei i atalii o Pasili o le Kiliata, ia i ai latou faatasi ma e o aai i lau laoai; aua na faapea ona latou o mai ia te au, ina o sola ese au ia Apisaloma lou uso.

verses.en: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.
verses.sm: Faauta mai foi, o loo ia te oe Semi le atalii o Kira o lo sa Peniaminá, mai Pauri, o le na fetuu ia te au ile fetuu leaga lava i le aso na ou alu atu ai i Maanaima; a ua alu ifo o ia e faafetaiai ia te au i Ioritana, ona ou tauto lea ia te ia i le ALU, ua faapea atu, Ou te le fasioti ia te oe i le pelu.

verses.en: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.
verses.sm: O lenei, aua e te faasaoina o ia; aua o oe o le tagata poto, ua e iloa foi le mea e tatau ona e fai ia te ia; a ia e faaoo lona ulusina ma le toto i le tuugamau.

verses.en: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
verses.sm: Ua taoto foi Tavita faatasi ma ona tama; ona tanumia lea o ia i le aai a Tavita.

verses.en: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.sm: O aso foi na fai ai Tavita ma tupu o Isaraelu e fagafulu o tausaga ia; e fitu tausaga na fai ai o ia ma tupu i Heperona; o tausaga e tolu sefulu ma le tolu na fai ai o ia ma tupu i Ierusalema.

verses.en: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
verses.sm: Ona tietie ai lea o Solomona i le nofoālii o lona tama o Tavita; ua matua faatumauina foi lona malo.

verses.en: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu Atonia le tama tane a Akita ia Patesepa le tinà o Solomona; ona fai mai lea o ia ia te ia, Po ua e sau ea ma le filemu? Ona tali atu lea o ia, Ua filemu lava.

verses.en: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi o ia, O laʻu feau ia te oe. Ona fai mai ai lea o ia, Ina fai mai ia.

verses.en: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's: for it was his from the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu lea o ia, Ua e iloa sa ia te au le nofoaiga, na faasagasaga mai foi Isaraelu uma ia te au ia fai afu ma tupu; a ua liua le nofoaiga, ua avea ma loʻu uso, aua ua fai ai mona mai le ALII.

verses.en: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
verses.sm: O lenei, ou te faatoga atu ia te oe i le mea e tasi, aua ne“ “alo ou fofoga ia te au. Ona fai mai ai lea o ia ia te ia, Ina fai mai ia.

verses.en: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia, Seʻi e fai atu i le tupu o Solomona, (aua na te le “alo ona fofoga ia te oe,) na te au mai ia te au o Apiseka o le Sunema e fai maʻu ava.

verses.en: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Patesepa, Ua lelei, ou te fai atu ai lava i le tupu ona o oe.

verses.en: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu lea o Patesepa i le tupu o Solomona e tautala atu ia te ia ona o Atonia. Ona tulai mai lea o le tupu e faafetaiai ia te ia, ma ua ifo mai i ai; ona tietie lea o ia i lona nofoalii, ua fai ane foi o ia e au mai se nofoa mo le tiná o le tupu; ona tietie ai lea o ia i lona itu taumatau.

verses.en: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia ia te ia, Ou te faatoga atu ia te oe i le mea itiiti e tasi; aua ne“ “alo ou fofoga ia te au. Ona fai mai lea o le tupu ia te ia, Sena e, fai mai ia, aua ou te le “alo lava ia te oe.

verses.en: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia, Se'i avatua Apiseka le Sunema ia Atonia lou uso e fai mana ava.

verses.en: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o le tupu o Solomona, ua faapea mai i lona tina, Se a ea le mea e te faatoga mai ai ia Apiseka le Sunema e fai ma aya a Atonia? Ina e faatoga mai foi i le nofoaiga e fai mona, auá o ia o lo'u uso e matua, ia ia te ia, atoa ma Aviata le faitaulaga, ma Ioapo le tama a Seruia.

verses.en: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
verses.sm: Ona tauto lea o le tupu o Solomona i le Aw, ua faapea mai, Ia faapea lava ona faia e le Atua ia te au, ma ia faaopoopo i ai, pe afai ua le fai mai e Atonia lena upu e fai ma mea e ou ai o ia.

verses.en: Now therefore, as the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
verses.sm: O lenei, o loo soifua le ALII o le ua faatumauina au, ma faanofoina aʻu i le nofoálii o loʻu tama o Tavita, o le ua faia foi se aiga moʻu, e pei ona ia fetalaia mai, e fasiotia lava Atonia i le aso nei.

verses.en: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
verses.sm: Ona auina atu lea e Solomona le tupu ia Penaia le atalii o leoiata, ua ia fasia o ia, ua oti ai.

verses.en: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi le tupu ia Aviata le faitaulaga, Ina alu ia oe i Anatota i lou fanua; aua e tatau ona e ou; a ou te le fasiotia oe i nei ona po; auá na e ave le atolaau ale Alii le ATUA i luma o loʻu tama o Tavita; aua foi na e tiga i mea uma lava na tigaina ai loʻu tama.

verses.en: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.sm: Ona tulia lea o Aviata e Solomona, aua neʻi toe fai o ia ma faitaulaga a le ALII; ina ia taunuu ai le afioga a le ALII na ia fetalaia mai ai i le aiga o Eli i Sailo.

verses.en: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.sm: Ua logo atu foi le tala ia Ioapo; Ona sola ai lea o Ioapo i le fale fetafai o le ALII, ma na tago atu i nifo o le fata faitaulaga; aua e ui lava ina lei liliu o Ioapo e mulimuli atu ia Apisaloma na ia liliu ma mulimuli atu ia Atonia.

verses.en: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
verses.sm: Ua taʻua foi i le tupu o Solomona, ua sola Ioapo i le fale fetafai o le ALII; faauta foi, o loo i tafatafa o le fata faitaulaga. Ona auina atu lea e Solomona o Penaia le atalii o Ieoiata, ua faapea atu, Alu ia oe, ina fasi ia te ia.

verses.en: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu lea o Penaia i le fale fetafai o le ALII, ua ia fai atu foi ia te ia, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le tupu, Ina sau ia oe i fafo. Ona tali mai lea o ia, E leai, ou te oti lava iinei. Ona toe taʻu atu lea e Penaia lena upu i le tupu, ua faapea atu, Ua faapea ona tautala mai o Ioapo, ua faapea foi ona tali mai o ia ia te au.

verses.en: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o le tupu ia te ia, Ia e faia e faapei ona fai mai aio ia, ia e fasi foi ia te ia, ma tanu ia te ia; ina ia e aveesea ia te au ma je aiga o loʻu tama, le toto na faamaligifuaina e Ioapo.

verses.en: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.
verses.sm: E taui atu e le ALII lona toto i lona lava ulu, ina ua fasia e ia o tagata e toalua sa sili ona amiotonu ma amio lelei ia te ia, na fasiotia i laua e ia i le pelu, na le silafia foi e lo'u tama o Tavita; o Apineru le atalii o Neru o le na pule i ‘au a Isaraelu, ma Amase le atalii o Ietero, o le na pule i ‘au a Iuta.

verses.en: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.
verses.sm: E tauia lava lo la toto i le ulu o Ioapo, ma ulu o ana fanau e faavavau; a o Tavita, ma lana fanau, ma lona aiga, ma lona nofoálii e i ai le manuia mai le ALII e faavavau.

verses.en: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
verses.sm: Ona alu ae lea o Penaia le atalii o leoiata, ma fasi ia te ia, ua ou ai; ua tanumia foi o ia i lona fale i le vao.

verses.en: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
verses.sm: Ona tofia lea e le tupu o Penaia le atalii o Ieoiata e fai mona sui e pule i ‘au; ua tofia foi e le tupu o Satoka le faitaulaga e sui a‘i Aviata.

verses.en: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
verses.sm: Ua aauina atu foi e le tupu nisi e aami ia Semi; ona fai atu lea o ia ia te ia, Ia e faia se fale mo oe i Ierusalema, ma e nofo ai, aua lava neʻi e alu ese i se tasi mea;

verses.en: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
verses.sm: ana o le aso e te alu ese atu ai, ma sopoia atu le alia o Ketarono, ia e matuā iloa, e te oti ai lava; e i lou ulu lou lava toto.

verses.en: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Semi i le tupu, Ua málie lau afioga; e pei ona fetalai mai o lo'u alii le tupu, e faapea ona faia e lau auauna. Ua nofo foi Semi i Ierusalema ua tele aso.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.
verses.sm: A ua oo ina atoa o tausaga e tolu, ona sosola ai lea o auauna e toalua a Semi ia Akisa le atalii o Maaka, o le tupu o Kata. Ua tala mai foi nisi ia Semi, ua faapea mai, Faauta, o loo i Kata au auauna.

verses.en: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
verses.sm: Ona tulai atu lea 0 Semi, ma faanofoa lana asini, ma alu atu i Kata ia Akisa e sailiili ai ana auauna; ua alu atu Semi, ma aumaia ana auauna mai Kata.

verses.en: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
verses.sm: Ua ta‘uina mai foi ia Solomona, na alu Semi nai Ierusalema i Kata, ma ua toe foi mai o ia.

verses.en: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.
verses.sm: Ona feau atu lea nisi e le tupu e aami ia Semi, ma na fai atu ia te ia, Na ou le fai atu ea ia te oe e te tauto i le ALH, ma aʻu ta'utino atu ia te oe, ua faapea atu, O le aso e te alu ese atu ai, ma e alu i se tasi mea, ia e matua iloa e te oti ai lava? Na e fai mai foi ia te au, Ua malie le upu ua ou faalogo atu ai.

verses.en: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?
verses.sm: Se a ea le mea na e le tausi ai le tautoga i le ALII, ma le poloaiga na Ou fai atu ai ia te oe?

verses.en: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;
verses.sm: Ua fai atu [foi le tupu ia Semi, Ua e iloa le leaga uma ua iloa ai lava i lou loto, na e fai i loʻu tamā o Tavita. O lenei, e taui atu a le ALII lou leaga i lou ulu;

verses.en: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.
verses.sm: a e manuia le tupu o Solomona, e faatumauina foi le nofoālii o Tavita i luma o le ALI e faavavau.

verses.en: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu ia Penaia le atalii o Ieoiata; ona alu atu lea o ia i fafo, ma fasi ia te ia, ua Oti ai o ia. Ua faatumauina lava le nofoaiga ia Solomona.
